title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E21 — Guy's Night Out
Mark tries to help Geneva's boyfriend become a part of his group of male friends with disastrous results. Nicole hides a stray cat in her room, but Vanessa is allergic to cats.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E22 — High Hopes
It looks like Mark, Geneva and Vanessa may all be leaving Oakland forever due to some unexpected surprises--good and bad--in this season finale cliffhanger.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E1 — Together Again
Mark, Vanessa and Geneva return to Oakland after their plans go awry. Geneva gets promoted to high school principal and wonders if she should rehire Mark.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E2 — It's A Matter Of Principal
Mark takes advantage of Geneva's position as high school principal. Vanessa refuses to return her wedding gifts, which gives Nicole and Tyler a naughty idea.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E3 — R.O.T.C
Mark becomes the faculty advisor for a student military program and learns that war games are no fun.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E4 — E.R
When Mark injures himself, Vanessa proves her medical skills.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E5 — Halloween
Nicole dares Tyler to stay all night in a haunted house on Halloween.Halloween episode.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E14 — Basketball Blues
Webster and Nicky discover that an up-and-coming basketball star is abusing cocaine.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E15 — Love Letters
When Nicky (Corky Nemac) has trouble writing to a girl (Ami Dolenz) he has a crush on, Webster comes through: excerpts from Katherine's old love letters.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E16 — Parental Guidance Suggested
Webster and his friends want to see a violent movie that one reviewer described as more violent than The Three Stooges at a hardware store. Katherine, George, and the other parents object until they see it first.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E17 — Rub-a-Dub-Dub
George and Katherine buy a hot tub that leaks so badly that it destroys the second floor bathroom.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E18 — See George Run
George investigates why he was suddenly dropped as an endorsed candidate for the Board of Education.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E15 — Mentor
Moesha is sentenced to do errands for an old woman who lives down the block because she stole oranges from her tree.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E16 — Break A Leg
Mo is teaching a dance class to young girls.  Myles wants to join because he has a crush on one of the girls.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E17 — Who Moved The Charity Stripe
Crenshaw High’s basketball team is one game away from the city finals.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E18 — Back To Africa
Moesha may have to bow out of the class trip to Africa when Frank invests all of the Mitchell savings in a Saturn dealership.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E19 — Strike A Pose
Moesha enters a modeling contest sponsored by a magazine being held at the Den.

S2 E9 — Washington Affair
Sandra's efforts to win the attention of a famous congressman (Robert Hooks) become muddled when Brenda's art teacher (Jayne Kennedy) catches his eye--yet in her pursuit she falls for another famous personality: Billy Dee Williams.

S2 E10 — Temptations
When Mary (Marla Gibbs) accepts the 'glamorous' title of Chairwoman of the Church benefit variety show, she soon realizes it's really a dirty job and prays for a group like the 'Temptations' to save the show.

S2 E11 — Father's Day
A surprise visit by his Air Force dad prompts Calvin to bid farewell to the family in exchange for a new life abroad with his father.

S2 E12 — Matchmakers
In efforts to find Rose a permanent mate, Mary and Sandra resort to a video dating service that transforms Rose into a Tina Turner look-a-like which eventually leads to an embarrassing and hilarious outcome when she meets her match.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E3 — Casino Evil
Stiff competition inspires Malcolm and Eddie to turn McGee's into a casino.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E4 — Sibling Rivals
Malcolm and his sister vie for the attention of the same woman.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E5 — A Police Officer And A Gentleman
Eddie is jealous when Nicolette agrees to accompany her commander to a police department dance.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E6 — The Courtship Of Eddie's Mother
Following her divorce, Eddie's mom arrives for a visit that coincides with one from Malcolm's dad.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E7 — Trading Spaces
Malcolm and Eddie decide to settle an argument by trading jobs for a day.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E18 — Watts Side Story
Fred is shocked when Lamont dates the sister of their Puerto Rican neighbor, Julio. The date becomes farcical when Fred's ploys to stop the date fail and he follows the couple -- in disguise.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E19 — Pops 'N Pals
Feeling jealous and neglected, Fred conjures up several ruses that will hopefully keep Lamont from spending so much time with Julio.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E20 — The Infernal Triangle
Lamont is upset when Fred announces that he plans to marry a young woman he has just met. When the young lady arrives at the house, Lamont is shocked to be face-to-face with one of his old girlfriends.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E21 — Home Sweet Home For The Aged
Fred is caught up in a series of frustrating situations when he becomes a resident of a senior citizens' home. Fred is put in the home by Lamont, who plans to work his way around the world on a tramp steamer and doesn't want to leave his father alone.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E22 — Pot Luck
Lamont outsmarts himself when he buys what he believes is a rare antique commode for only $20. Fred disapproves of the deal. Lamont insists that he can sell it for $400. Mr. Osborne, husband of the woman who sold the item, offers to buy it back for $200.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E23 — The Kid
Nine-year-old Jason (Lincoln Kilpatrick Jr.) worms his way into the Sanford yard and eventually into Fred's heart. Touched by the runaway's loneliness, Fred gets an idea to help others like Jason -- but he's not prepared for the results.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E17 — Lionel Gets The Business
George is on cloud nine when he finally persuades Lionel to join him in the family's cleaning business -- until Lionel starts taking him to the cleaners.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E18 — Blackout, The
George blows a fuse when a power blackout hits the city and looters do the same to his store.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E19 — Florence's Union
Florence wants to form a union for maids and succeeds in breaking up the whole household.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E20 — George And Jimmy
When George calls President Carter as a publicity stunt, he gets more publicity than he expected and the Jeffersons get a night they'll never forget.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E21 — Thomas H. Willis & Co
When Tom Willis makes opening his own business more important than his family and friends, he may get the business but lose everything else.
